home.name: Lazar
home.heroLine2: I work as a System & Network Administrator, responsible for keeping complex server environments stable and operational. My daily work revolves around reliability, continuity and real-world responsibility.
home.heroLine3: Alongside that, I build web applications with an understanding of how systems behave beyond the interface.
home.tagline1: Systems fail — it’s an unavoidable part of the job.
home.tagline2: My responsibility is to prevent what can be prevented and control what cannot.
